protocol: sample graph diagnostics -> participant averaging -> condition summary
attack_rule: At each step, remove the current-path edge with highest baseline path-use frequency.
notes: Lower edge weight w means stronger inferred microbial support.
Penalised bottleneck weight assigns no-path cases to w=1.
Penalised path length assigns no-path cases to the fixed length_failure_value.
Reachable-fraction plot should be read together with penalised bottleneck/path-length plots.
